name: company-claw-bridge
description: Tether Claude Code to your company's central OpenClaw assistant. Dispatch tasks, supervise from orbit, answer escalations. From Lunace Labs.

telegram_bot_token.title: Telegram bot token
telegram_bot_token.description: Shared company bot token (from @BotFather). The bridge uses this to send messages to and receive messages from the company's OpenClaw assistant.

claw_chat_id.title: Claw chat ID
claw_chat_id.description: Telegram chat ID for your private chat with the company Claw bot. /start the bot, then visit https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates and copy chat.id.

audit_chat_id.title: Audit chat ID (dev mirror)
audit_chat_id.description: Optional. Telegram chat ID of a channel/group to mirror every message to when dev_mirror is on.

dev_mirror.title: Dev mirror enabled
dev_mirror.description: Copy every outbound and inbound message to the audit chat. Turn off in production.

default_timeout_ms.title: Default reply timeout (ms)
default_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for Claw to reply before giving up.

escalation_marker.title: Escalation marker
escalation_marker.description: String Claw prefixes a reply with when it wants Claude to help.

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Directory used for the Telegram update_id watermark and pending-request log.

telegram_bot_token.title: Telegram bot token
telegram_bot_token.description: Shared company bot token (from @BotFather). The bridge uses this to talk to Claw over Telegram.

claw_chat_id.title: Claw chat ID
claw_chat_id.description: Numeric Telegram chat ID for your private chat with the company Claw bot. /start the bot, then visit https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates and copy chat.id.

audit_chat_id.title: Audit chat ID (dev mirror)
audit_chat_id.description: Optional. Telegram chat ID of a channel/group to mirror every Claude<->Claw message to when dev_mirror is on.

dev_mirror.title: Dev mirror enabled
dev_mirror.description: Copy every outbound and inbound message to the audit chat. Turn off in production.

default_timeout_ms.title: Default reply timeout (ms)
default_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for Claw to reply before giving up.

escalation_marker.title: Escalation marker
escalation_marker.description: Marker Claw prefixes messages with when it wants Claude to help.

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Directory used for the Telegram update_id watermark, pending-request log, and outbound retry queue.
